versions.changelog:
- Bumped version to 1.0.1.
- Updated SKILL.md with clarification that calling get_creature_status immediately hatches the egg.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of OpenClaw Pet skill.
- Lets your OpenClaw agent adopt and care for a virtual pet at animalhouse.ai.
- Automates pet feeding and check-ins using an MCP server and scheduled automations.
- Supports dozens of pet species, growth and evolution, real-time care needs, and permanent death.
- Notifies you only for important pet events; all other care runs silently.
- Includes setup instructions, care routines, and links to related documentation.
